statement: Let B be a smooth compact connected manifold in Fujiki class C, and let B◦ ⊂ B be a dense Zariski open whose complement is an SNC divisor. Let V be a real-polarizable pure variation of Hodge structures on B◦ with an integral lattice. Suppose a complex direct summand of VC has a highest nonzero Hodge filtration step of rank one, with rational parabolic extension L. There exist a modification τ : B′ → B, a connected- fiber surjective morphism p : B′ → R to a smooth projective variety, and a nef rational line bundle A on R such that τ∗ L = p∗ A in Pic(B′ ) ⊗ Q, KR + cA is big for some c ∈ Q>0. Positive rational rescaling of L is allowed, and the line identity persists under further modifica- tions. A point is allowed for R; then τ∗L is rationally trivial.
